title: On Facilitating the talk between the two sides
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：facilitate　|　正文 362 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 facilitate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the coach ① facilitated the talk between the two sides without a word of thanks, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② facilitates the talk between the two sides at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ facilitate the talk between the two sides at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ facilitated the talk between the two sides before — a line in the record for April 1960 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Facilitating the talk between the two sides without a word of thanks, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ facilitate the sharing of the catch at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Facilitate the sharing of the catch at once and never mention it again.

By 1973 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ facilitates the sharing of the catch without a word of thanks every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ facilitated the talk between the two sides again when nobody else would.

⑩ To facilitate the talk between the two sides, my mother said in 1978, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody facilitates the talk between the two sides at once again and somebody must facilitate the talk between the two sides without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 促成（一般过去式 facilitated the talk between the two sides：1966 年教练头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 促成（一般现在 facilitates the talk between the two sides：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 促成（不定式 to facilitate the talk between the two sides：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 促成（过去完成时 had facilitated the talk between the two sides：1960 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 促成（动名词 facilitating the talk between the two sides 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使便利（facilitate the sharing of the catch：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使便利便于把渔获分给众人）
G. v. 使便利（facilitate the sharing of the catch：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 促成（后段两处：新来的队员照例 facilitates the sharing of the catch，而母亲又一次 facilitated the talk between the two sides）

answers.why: facilitate 意为“促成”，1966 年教练不图一句谢促成促成双方的谈话，那是球场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 facilitated。
facilitate 意为“促成”，自那以后教练二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 facilitates。
facilitate 意为“促成”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯促成促成双方的谈话”，此处为不定式 to facilitate the talk between the two sides。
facilitate 意为“促成”，赛事记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1973 年之前就有人促成过，故用过去完成时 had facilitated。
facilitate 意为“促成”，教练说“促成促成双方的谈话这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 facilitating the talk between the two sides 作主语。
facilitate 意为“使便利”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使便利便于把渔获分给众人”，should ever 之后用原形 facilitate the sharing of the catch。
facilitate 意为“使便利”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使便利便于把渔获分给众人（facilitate the sharing of the catch at once），以后再也不要提起。
facilitate 意为“促成”，新来的队员每个赛季都照例使便利便于把渔获分给众人，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 facilitates。
facilitate 意为“促成”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢促成促成双方的谈话，用一般过去式 facilitated 叙述。
facilitate 意为“促成”，结尾那句是母亲 1978 年的话：要促成促成双方的谈话，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

answers: In 1966 the coach facilitated the talk between the two sides without a word of thanks, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three seasons on, the coach still facilitates the talk between the two sides at once without being asked.
My mother said later that to facilitate the talk between the two sides at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had facilitated the talk between the two sides long before 1973, and the line in the record for April proves it.
Facilitating the talk between the two sides without a word of thanks, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 facilitate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the coach facilitated the talk between the two sides without a word of thanks, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach facilitates the talk between the two sides at once whenever the field asks.
Facilitating the talk between the two sides without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever facilitate the sharing of the catch at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field facilitates the sharing of the catch without a word of thanks every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother facilitated the talk between the two sides again, and the field remembered that half.
